notes.title: Small Patch: Album controls
notes.content:
Added few album controls:
- Right Mouse Click will close the opened image.
- Mouse Wheel moving album up and down

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: 🎉 New Update – Videos Are Here!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]I’ve just released a brand new update for the game! [/p][p]Until now, you could only enjoy Ladyboys through photos, but starting with this patch, videos have been added too.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing and supporting the game![/p]
